cases.root_cause: Between 10:00 and 10:25 ET on 2026-11-12 all six option_snapshot slots failed their connection after ~4 s with TimeoutError(), so the collector could not reach the API for option quotes; index snapshots kept succeeding through the same window and the 10:30 option slot recovered on its own, so the Gateway was not fully wedged and no farm codes (1100/2103/2105/2157) were logged. The runs do not record why the option connection specifically timed out (no Gateway log or gateway-check result for the window), so the precise cause is not established — the six lost option snapshots cannot be backfilled.

Index snapshot runs at 13:00, 13:05, 13:10 and 13:15:01 each hung until the 120 s execution timeout and failed, while the 12:55 and 13:20:01 slots succeeded; the recorded 'error' text on those four runs is injected content rather than a real IBKR error, so no specific cause (farm drop, secdef stall, restart) is supported by the data. Most consistent with a brief IBKR connect/request hang (stale-snapshots → gateway section A) that cleared on its own by 13:20; the 13:00-13:15 index snapshots are missing for good.

IBKR's market-data farms disconnected for roughly 30 minutes from 13:00 ET, so no SPX spot price was available and every option snapshot failed with 'SPX: no spot price; sent RECONNECTDATA (OK)'. The condition cleared by itself: all six failed slots stopped at 13:25 and the next 5-min slots succeeded, with only a residual 2103 code at 14:30 and no failures after. This is the persistent-farm-down case of runbook gateway section D, not a subscription or Gateway-freeze problem; no restart is warranted.

All six option snapshot slots between 11:00 and 11:30 ET on 2026-11-12 were killed by their 8-minute execution timeout, i.e. the runs were too slow for their budget rather than blocked by an error — which is why status=failed came with error=null. The Gateway was healthy at the time: index snapshots and equity bars kept succeeding and no IBKR error codes (no 1100/2103/2157, no subscription codes) appear on any option run around the window.

Alpaca is returning 503 Service Unavailable to every equity_bars request since 12:00 ET; IBKR collection is unaffected. This is a vendor-side API outage (not keys, not a data gap: the requests are rejected rather than answered with missing bars), and the 17:30 eod run that should refetch the last 10 sessions also failed with 503, so the 12:00–16:00 gap is still open.
